description: This file defines a module for creating an ElementTree-based TreeWalker class, which traverses XML/HTML trees without recursion, providing node details and navigation methods.

classes.name: TreeWalker
classes.description: A non-recursive tree walker for ElementTree structures, providing node detail extraction and navigation methods.

methods.name: getNodeDetails
methods.description: Returns details about a given node, including type, tag, attributes, and content.

methods.name: getFirstChild
methods.description: Retrieves the first child node of a given node.

methods.name: getNextSibling
methods.description: Retrieves the next sibling of a given node.

methods.name: getParentNode
methods.description: Returns the parent node of a given node.
